sources.snippet: 🛰️ SatQuery AI — Multimodal Satellite Vision-Language Model SatQuery is a parameter-efficient fine-tuned Vision-Language Model (VLM) engineered for multi-sensor Earth Observation, disaster response, and change detection.

sources.title: SatQuery AI — Satellite image Q&A
sources.snippet: Ask satellite imagery in plain English — see the evidence on the map. Upload images or run a query. We route your question to the right AI model and show you highlighted map proof alongside a clear answer for regions across India.

sources.snippet: Overview SatQuery AI is an advanced multimodal remote-sensing and geospatial intelligence system developed for the ISRO AI Hackathon. Rather than deploying a generic vision-language model, SatQuery implements an Autonomous Agentic Orchestration Pipeline.
